Job Title: Software Developer

Location: Remote | Philippines based ONLY

Salary Range: Php 190,000 per month

Mobile App Developer (React Native)



We’re looking for a talented Mobile App Developer to join our remote-first team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining high-quality, responsive mobile applications using React Native, TypeScript, and modern mobile development tools.



Our ideal candidate has strong React Native experience, writes clean and maintainable code, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where autonomy, communication, and craftsmanship are valued.



Key Responsibilities



* Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript.

* Build responsive, performant, and user-friendly mobile experiences across iOS and Android platforms.

* Work with Expo, Xcode, Android Studio, and mobile development workflows to build, test, and deploy applications.

* Integrate third-party APIs, including reading, understanding, and applying API documentation.

* Work with backend services, databases, and APIs to deliver complete mobile features.

* Implement clean UI components and follow mobile UX best practices.

* Utilise AI-powered tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, and similar) to accelerate development while maintaining high code quality and exercising sound engineering judgment over AI-generated output.

* Collaborate with other developers and/or stakeholders to refine requirements, propose technical solutions, and deliver features on agreed timelines.

* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across development, testing, and production environments.

* Manage app releases, updates, and deployments through relevant mobile platforms.

* Produce clear technical documentation for features, architectural decisions, and processes.

* Communicate proactively and clearly within a remote team, including written updates and participation in online meetings across UK-Philippines time zones.



Must-Have Skills:



* Strong proficiency in React Native and TypeScript.

* Proven experience building and shipping mobile applications for iOS and Android.

* Strong understanding of React principles, component architecture, and state management.

* Experience working with REST APIs, third-party integrations, and backend services.

* Familiarity with mobile development tools including Expo, Xcode, and Android Studio.

* Understanding of responsive layouts, mobile UI patterns, and performance optimisation.

* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows.

* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

* Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining engineering judgment and security best practices.



Nice-to-Have Skills:



* Experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL-backed applications.

* Experience deploying apps through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

* Familiarity with Next.js, React web applications, or full-stack development.

* Experience with push notifications, deep linking, offline storage, or mobile analytics.

* Experience with Vercel, serverless functions, or backend integrations.



Tech Stack



Primary:



* React Native

* TypeScript

* Expo

* React

* REST APIs



Secondary / Bonus:



* Supabase (PostgreSQL)

* Next.js

* Python



Tools & Platforms:



* Git / GitHub

* Xcode

* Android Studio

* Expo

* App Store Connect / Google Play Console

* Standard remote collaboration tools (Slack/Teams, Jira/Linear or equivalent)

- Your previous experience as a Mobile App Developer  and specific experience with React Native

title: Online Booking Agent – Flexible Part-Time, Performance Pay
description:
Job Title: Online Booking Agent (Part-Time, Pay Per Booking)



## About the Job



We run a service that helps clients secure visa appointment slots at consulates/embassies. Appointment slots on the official visa portals open at specific times and get taken within minutes — your job is to be logged in, ready, and fast.



We are hiring a few reliable, detail-oriented people for this role. This is simple but high-focus work: no cold calling, no selling, no content writing. You just need to be sharp, punctual, and quick with a mouse and keyboard.



## What You Will Do



- Log in to the official visa appointment portal at specific scheduled times (we will tell you the exact date and time in advance)

- Monitor the portal for appointment slots as they are released

- Immediately book an available slot using the client details we provide you

- Fill in applicant information accurately (names, passport numbers, dates — zero typos allowed)

- Confirm the booking and send us proof (screenshot + confirmation details) right away

- Report back promptly if no slots were available during your session



## Schedule

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities



Market & bench building

*Build and continuously expand TriArc’s qualified trade partner database by trade, geography, capacity, and performance.

*Run ongoing prequalification (financials, safety, workload, bonding) in coordination with Accounting.



Bid strategy & scheduling

*Publish the rolling Bid Calendar; align milestones with Estimators/PMs and owners/architects.

*Break down drawings/specs into clear trade packages; assign scope sheets and alternates.



ITB execution

*Prepare Invitation to Bid packages (drawings, specs, addenda, bid forms, alternates, due dates, delivery method).

*Post to BuildingConnected; segment targeted lists; personalize top-tier outreach.



Relentless follow-up

*3-touch cadence (Day 1
 + Day 3 call/text + Day 5 confirmation) and pre-deadline “nudge” to secure commitments.

*Track interest/no-bid reasons; backfill gaps early; escalate risk areas to Estimating.



Bid intake & leveling

*Receive bids, confirm inclusions/exclusions, and level against scope sheets; flag outliers and VE options.

*Package a clean Bid Leveling Matrix for Estimators/PMs with award recommendation.



Data & feedback loops

*Score and rate trade partner performance post-award (price accuracy, quality, safety, schedule).

*Run post-bid debriefs; capture lessons learned to refine future ITBs.



Brand & relationship

*Be TriArc’s front door for subs: fast answers, fair process, respectful communication, and values-based partnership.



Required Traits & Skills

*Excellent Communication Skills

*Hunter mentality: proactive, persistent, upbeat on the phone; comfortable making 30–50 quality contacts/day in peak cycles.

*Construction fluency: understands typical scopes (CSI divisions), alternates, addenda, and gaps that derail bids.

*Process discipline: lives in checklists, documents everything.

*Communication: crisp writing, professional phone presence, tact with hard-bid deadlines.

*Values fit: Do what you say • Do the right thing • Gumption • Stick-to-itiveness • Passion/Enthusiasm.



Nice-to-Have

*Customer Service / Appointment Setting experience

*GC pre-con/bid desk experience or supplier/manufacturer rep background.

*Existing DFW sub network across interiors, ground-up flex/industrial, retail shells.



Technical Requirements:

*Computer: Intel i5 processor or equivalent with at least 8GB RAM

*Internet: Minimum 50 MBPS download speed

*Dual Monitor is required

*Noise cancellation headset

*HD Cam (Clutter Free, Ideally Plain Well-lit background)



Job Details:

Job Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM - 5:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: PHP 70,000 – 90,000 monthly, depending on experience.

/appqNAvkEQ10YFlc3/pagO7KL90nGSfhiE9/form

description:

We are looking for a talented, creative, and highly reliable Video Editor from the Philippines to join our team for a long-term position. This is an output-based role where you will be responsible for delivering 3 high-quality edited videos per day, every day (short-form content for Meta Ads /
 & Instagram Reels).



We will fully onboard and train you on our specific video concepts and styles that are already proven to work. If you understand fast pacing, engaging hooks, text animations, and how to keep the viewer's attention, you will thrive in this position. Since this is a consistent, daily role, we offer a very competitive monthly salary for the right candidate. videos that you gonna editing can be in all diffrent Language

-Edit raw footage into polished, high-engaging vertical videos.

-Add dynamic captions, subtitles, sound effects (SFX), and background music.

The videos will be short-form vertical content (TikTok/Reels/Shorts style in 9:16), typically between 10 to 60 seconds long per video.



Follow guidelines and maintain a consistent editing style.

Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.



Great attention to detail and ability to implement constructive feedback quickly.

Language: All communication, instructions, and feedback will be in English.



Project Management: We will use Google Drive to share raw assets and upload finished videos. 



Salary & Hours:



Type: Part-time/fulltime (Around 20-25 hours per week). Fully output-based (3 videos/day).



Salary: $850 USD per month (Fixed flat rate based on full daily delivery). Paid bi-weekly or monthly via bank transfer.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
HIRING: Full Time Virtual Assistant

Tolivas Beauty Club — TBC Studios Official

Quezon City, Philippines (Remote)

=============================================

WHO WE ARE

Tolivas Beauty Club and TBC Studios Official

is a Philippine hair export company selling

premium single-donor Filipino virgin hair

to buyers in the USA, Europe, and the

Middle East. We also supply hair felt

products for oil spill remediation to

government and industrial clients.

We are a small company with big ambitions

and we need someone who shares that energy.

=============================================

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Before we talk about tasks — we want to

talk about character. Because the right

person matters more to us than the right

certificate.

We are looking for someone who is:

SELF-MOTIVATED

You do not wait to be told what to do next.

When you finish a task you find the next

one. You manage your time without needing

constant supervision.

TEAM ORIENTED

You understand that your work affects

everything else. You communicate proactively

when something goes wrong. You celebrate

when the business wins because it is your

win too.

FOCUSED ON GROWTH

You want to learn. You want to get better.

You see this role not just as a job but as

an opportunity to develop real skills in

export business, international sales, and

online marketing.

A GREAT COMMUNICATOR

You write clear professional English
s.

You respond promptly. You ask questions

when you are unsure rather than guessing

wrong. You represent our brand with warmth

and professionalism.

VERY RESILIENT

This role involves outreach. Most people

you contact will not respond. Some will

say no. A few will say yes — and those

yeses build the business. You need to be

someone who can hear no twenty times and

send the twenty-first
 with the same

energy as the first.

SOMEONE WHO SEES THINGS THROUGH

You enjoy taking something from beginning

to end. You do not start tasks and leave

them half finished. You follow up. You

close loops. You make sure things land.

SOMEONE WHO LIKES OVERCOMING CHALLENGES

This business is new and growing. Things

will not always go smoothly. We want

someone who finds that exciting rather than

frustrating. Problems are opportunities

here — not obstacles.

DEDICATED EVEN WHEN IT IS HARD

When buyers do not respond. When suppliers

change their prices. When a deal falls

through. You stay dedicated to the mission

because you believe in what we are building.

=============================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

— Research and contact hair distributors,

salon buyers, doll supply companies,

felt manufacturers, and oil spill response

companies worldwide

— Send 15 to 20 personalized outreach


s per day

— Follow up on all open conversations

— Manage our Alibaba, Etsy, and

inboxes

— Post in relevant
 and online

communities

— Track all activity in a Google Sheets CRM

— Send a short daily report each afternoon

— Research new buyer leads by city and

industry as directed

=============================================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

— Excellent written English — non-negotiable

— Reliable internet — minimum 10 Mbps

— Own laptop or desktop

— Available Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm

— Experience with
 outreach or

online sales is a strong advantage

— Familiarity with Alibaba, Etsy, or

e-commerce is helpful but not required

=============================================

WHAT WE OFFER

— Full time role — Monday to Friday

— ?12,000 to ?16,000 per month depending

on experience

— SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG contributions

— 13th month pay

— Work from home — no commute

— Direct access to the founder

— Real responsibility from Day 1

— Opportunity to grow with the business

as it scales internationally

=============================================

HOW TO APPLY

Send us a message with:

 1. A 3 to 5 sentence introduction about

yourself and why this role fits you

 2. One example of a time you kept going

after hearing no or facing a setback

 3. Your internet speed (run a speed test

at fast.com and share the result)

Applications without all three will not

be considered. We read every application

that follows the instructions.

=============================================

Tolivas Beauty Club — TBC Studios Official

Quezon City, Philippines



We are building something meaningful.

We want someone who wants to build it

with us.

title: Amazon Marketplace Growth & Global Sourcing Manager (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Amazon Marketplace Growth & Global Sourcing Manager (Full-Time, Remote)



About Us



We are a rapidly growing North American industrial products company expanding our Amazon business.



Our product categories include industrial supplies, warehouse equipment, construction accessories, PPE, abrasives, adhesives, packaging products, material handling equipment, safety products, and related commercial products.



We source products globally and are looking for an experienced Amazon professional to take ownership of our marketplace growth.



**This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who has successfully built and managed large Amazon businesses and can independently drive profitable growth.



---



Your Mission



Own and grow our Amazon business by identifying profitable products, sourcing quality manufacturers, launching new products, optimizing listings, managing advertising campaigns, and maximizing profitability.



---



Key Responsibilities



 Amazon Growth Strategy



* Develop and execute a long-term Amazon growth strategy.

* Identify opportunities to expand our product catalog.

* Increase revenue while maintaining strong profit margins.

* Monitor competitors and industry trends.



Product Research & Global Sourcing



* Identify profitable products that align with our business.

* Source manufacturers in China and other overseas markets.

* Negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.

* Evaluate suppliers for quality, reliability, and certifications.

* Coordinate samples, testing, and production.



Amazon Listing Management



* Create and optimize Amazon listings.

* Perform keyword research and Amazon SEO.

* Write high-converting titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords.

* Develop A+ Content and Brand Store pages.

* Improve conversion rates through continuous optimization.



Amazon Advertising



* Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Optimize PPC performance.

* Reduce ACOS while maintaining growth.

* Improve TACOS and overall profitability.

* Scale successful advertising campaigns.



Inventory & Operations



* Forecast inventory demand.

* Coordinate FBA shipments.

* Prevent stock-outs and excess inventory.

* Monitor SKU performance and recommend improvements.



Profitability



* Analyze margins for every SKU.

* Recommend pricing strategies.

* Scale winning products.

* Identify and discontinue underperforming products.



---



Minimum Requirements



**Please do not apply unless you meet the following requirements.**



Required Experience



* Personally managed an Amazon Seller Central account generating **at least US$2 million in annual sales.**

* Minimum **5 years** of Amazon marketplace experience.

* Proven success launching and scaling Amazon products.

* Strong experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns.

* Experience sourcing products directly from China and/or other overseas manufacturers.

* Experience working with Amazon FBA.

* Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.



Preferred Experience



Experience selling products in one or more of the following categories:



* Industrial supplies

* Construction products

* PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)

* Safety equipment

* Abrasives

* Adhesives

* Material handling

* Packaging supplies

* Warehouse equipment

* Commercial or B2B products



Software Experience



Experience with some or all of the following:



* Amazon Seller Central

* Helium 10

* Keepa

* Jungle Scout

* DataDive

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* Alibaba

* Global Sources



---



Compensation



* Competitive monthly salary based on experience.

* Performance bonuses tied to profitable growth.

* Long-term, full-time opportunity.

* Significant opportunity for career growth as our Amazon business expands.



---



Required With Your Application



Applications that do not answer the following questions will not be considered.



1. What is the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed?

2. What was the annual revenue of that account?

3. How many SKUs did you manage?

4. What were your primary responsibilities?

5. What monthly PPC budget did you manage?

6. What was your average ACOS?

7. What was your average TACOS?

8. How many products have you personally launched?

9. Describe your most successful Amazon product launch.

10. Describe your experience sourcing products from China or other overseas manufacturers.

11. Which Amazon software tools do you use daily?

12. Please provide proof of your experience managing Amazon accounts (screenshots with confidential information hidden are acceptable).



---



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 12 months, you will:



* Launch multiple profitable products.

* Build strong relationships with overseas manufacturers.

* Improve the profitability of our existing catalog.

* Grow Amazon revenue while maintaining healthy margins.

* Develop repeatable systems for sourcing, launching, advertising, and scaling products.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career and become a key leader in our growing e-commerce business.

title: Bookkeeper – E-commerce, Payroll & BAS Experience
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced and degree-qualified Bookkeeper with strong e-commerce accounting experience to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing consistent payroll processing, BAS preparation and lodgement support, and maintaining accurate financial records in compliance with Australian accounting standards and requirements.



This role requires a professional with proven local Australian experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage bookkeeping functions across a fast-paced e-commerce environment.



Key Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end bookkeeping functions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

Process and reconcile e-commerce transactions across platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, eBay, marketplaces, payment gateways, and related systems.

Perform daily reconciliation of sales, fees, refunds, payment processors, and inventory-related transactions.

Prepare financial reports, including profit and loss statements, balance sheet reconciliations, and management reports.

Process payroll accurately and on time, including:

PAYG withholding

Superannuation payments

Payroll reconciliations

Leave calculations

Single Touch Payroll (STP) compliance

Prepare and assist with Business Activity Statement (BAS) submissions, including GST reconciliations and supporting documentation.

Maintain accurate records in accordance with Australian taxation and accounting requirements.

Liaise with accountants, auditors, and external advisors as required.

Assist with month-end and year-end financial processes.

Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, reporting accuracy, and financial controls.



Skills & Experience Required

Degree qualified in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Demonstrated Australian bookkeeping experience with knowledge of local accounting practices and compliance requirements.

Proven experience supporting BAS preparation and lodgement processes.

Strong payroll experience, including Australian payroll legislation, PAYG, superannuation, and STP requirements.

Previous experience working with e-commerce businesses and high-volume online transactions.

Experience with accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or similar platforms.

Experience integrating accounting systems with e-commerce platforms and payment providers is highly desirable.

Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.

Excellent organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

Previous experience in a retail, e-commerce, or online business environment.

Xero certification or similar accounting software certification.

Experience working with inventory accounting and multi-channel sales environments.

Exposure to Australian tax compliance and reporting requirements.



What We Offer

Work within local Australian Western Standard Time (AWST) business hours.

Opportunity to be part of a growing e-commerce-focused business with exciting growth opportunities.

A professional, supportive, and collaborative working environment.

Exposure to a broad range of financial operations and business processes.

Competitive remuneration package aligned with experience, qualifications, and skills.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accounting Support
description:
About Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors:

We are a dynamic financial services firm dedicated to providing tailored tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial services to both individuals and businesses. Our approach is client-centric, ensuring personalized service that meets the unique needs of each client for optimal outcomes. Staying abreast of tax law and financial trends, our expert team is committed to continuous learning and adaptation. Our mission is to empower clients by maintaining their financial health today and proactively planning for their tomorrow.



Role Overview:



Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors is seeking a highly capable Bookkeeper / Accounting Support Contractor to support client bookkeeping, accounting cleanup, financial reporting, and advisory preparation work. This role is ideal for a self-directed accounting professional who understands bookkeeping is more than data entry. We need someone who can review financial activity, identify issues, communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and help maintain clean, decision-ready books for business clients.

The role involves managing QuickBooks accounts, supporting clients, and contributing to our team's collaborative efforts to meet client needs. The ideal candidate has strong QuickBooks Online and Xero experience, understands accounting fundamentals, can manage client accounts independently, and communicates proactively when questions, issues, or bottlenecks arise. This role requires professional judgment, accountability, and the ability to work with limited supervision.



Primary Responsibilities:



Bookkeeping & Account Management

Maintain accurate books for assigned client accounts.

Categorize transactions properly based on client activity and accounting principles.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant accounts, payroll accounts, and other balance sheet accounts.

Review financial statements for obvious errors, inconsistencies, unusual balances, and missing activity.

Maintain clean, organized, and supportable books for each client.

Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual bookkeeping close processes.

Track outstanding client questions, missing documents, and unresolved transactions.

Support cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects when assigned.

Prepare client books for tax preparation, tax planning, or advisory review.



Accounting Review & Quality Control

Identify uncategorized, misclassified, duplicate, or unsupported transactions.

Review balance sheet accounts for reasonableness.

Flag negative loan balances, shareholder distributions, owner draws, retained earnings issues, payroll inconsistencies, and unusual expense activity.

Understand the difference between ordinary expenses, capital assets, loans, equity, distributions, and reimbursements.

Recognize when depreciation, amortization, fixed assets, loan treatment, payroll, or tax-sensitive classifications may require review.

Maintain documentation for bookkeeping decisions and client-provided support.

Escalate technical questions before making unsupported assumptions.



Software & Workflow

Work primarily in QuickBooks Online and Xero.

Use firm-approved project management, document management, and communication tools.

Follow established client workflows, task assignments, naming conventions, and deadlines.

Update task status clearly and consistently.

Document work performed, open issues, assumptions, and pending client needs.

Assist with process improvement when recurring problems are identified.



Client & Team Communication

Communicate clearly in writing and verbally.

Provide concise updates on work status, missing information, and client issues.

Ask focused questions when clarification is needed.

Communicate challenges early enough to protect deadlines.

Provide proposed solutions whenever possible.

Participate in scheduled internal check-ins as needed.

Maintain professionalism and confidentiality at all times.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Experience supporting tax firms, accounting firms, or advisory practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

Both QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor and Xero Advisor Certifications.

Experience independently managing client bookkeeping accounts.

Strong understanding of GAAP fundamentals.

Experience with multiple business types and industries.

Familiarity with U.S. small business tax concepts.

Familiarity with tax-sensitive bookkeeping concepts, including depreciation, capital assets, loans, payroll, owner equity, and deductible versus nondeductible expenses.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Must be able to pass a background check and be bondable due to access to confidential client financial information.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial data.



Preferred Qualifications

Have at least two U.S. based references.

Experience preparing books for tax preparation or tax planning.

Payroll bookkeeping experience.

Experience with real estate, medical practices, professional services, construction, cannabis, retail, or service-based businesses.

Experience with cleanup bookkeeping projects.

Experience using workflow tools such as TaxDome, Basecamp, Trello, Asana, Karbon, Financial Cents, or similar platforms.

Experience with document request workflows and client communication tracking.



Technology, Security & Data Protection Requirements

Because this role involves access to confidential client financial records, tax-related documents, bookkeeping systems, and firm information, the contractor must maintain a secure remote work environment and comply with all firm technology and data protection requirements.



The contractor must be able to meet and maintain minimum security standards, including but not limited to:

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Secure, password-protected computer used for professional work.

Updated operating system and software.

Active anti-malware / antivirus protection.

Properly configured firewall protection.

Use of a firm-approved VPN when required.

Multi-factor authentication for all approved systems.

Secure password management practices.

No shared use of firm logins, client files, or confidential data.

No saving client documents to unauthorized personal devices, drives, or cloud storage.

Compliance with all firm procedures for document access, storage, transmission, and deletion.



The contractor must promptly report any suspected security issue, lost or compromised device, unauthorized access, malware i
, password compromise, or data exposure concern.



Failure to maintain required security standards may result in immediate removal of system access and termination of the contractor relationship.



Background Check, Bondability & Trust Requirements

Because this role involves access to sensitive client financial records, business accounts, tax-related documents, and confidential firm information, candidates must be able to successfully complete a background check and be bondable.

The selected contractor must demonstrate a professional history suitable for handling confidential financial information, client records, bookkeeping systems, and related account access. Any background concern that may affect financial trust, confidentiality, client security, or professional reliability must be disclosed during the screening process.

Candidates must also agree to follow all firm confidentiality, data security, document handling, password management, and client privacy requirements.



Contractor Classification

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor is responsible for managing their own work environment, equipment, internet access, taxes, insurance, and any other obligations associated with independent contractor status. This role does not create an employer-employee relationship.



Application Process

Application Deadline: June 8th 11:59 AM Philippine Standard Time.

Interested candidates should complete our application: 



Elite 8 Tax & Business Advisors is an equal opportunity employer, valuing diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment.



*Important Note* Please do not directly contact anyone on our team. We are thoroughly reviewing each application and will provide communication to everyone about their status moving forward.

description:

(Immediate Hire: Looking to fill this role within the next 7 days)



About Us:

We operate a fast-paced, highly dynamic portfolio of businesses based in the US, including luxury event venues, real estate/construction projects, corporate housing, and energy therapy and hypnosis retreats.



Our core mission is to build a thriving network of clients and vendors whom we mentor and serve with exceptional value, executing every facet of our business from a foundational frequency of unconditional love and light. We are visionaries. We know exactly what we want to achieve, but we need an execution expert to build the systems and nurture the leads.



The Opportunity:

We are not looking for a general marketing VA to write blogs or run paid ads. We are looking for a highly motivated Growth Partner focused entirely on **System Building and Lead Closing**.



You will fix and build our GoHighLevel (GHL) funnels and "own" the leads that come through them. While we handle all of the actual phone calling and physical fulfillment, YOU will handle all the
 and SMS follow-ups within GHL. When your system and your messaging result in a closed booking, you get paid a commission on top of your hourly base rate.



Your Responsibilities (You are the Engine):



Comprehensive GHL Ecosystem Management:** You are responsible for the *entirety* of our GoHighLevel platform. This includes building and managing workflows, triggers, pipelines, calendars, snapshots, forms/surveys, membership/course areas, and payment distribution integrations.



Technical Architecture & Compliance: You will handle domain migrations, DNS record management, and A2P 10DLC SMS compliance. If a webhook, Zap, or API connection isn't firing, you diagnose and fix it. You will build custom backend logic, such as an unbundled, a-la-carte booking system for our venue.

 

Future-Proofing (No Scope Creep):  GoHighLevel updates constantly. Learning, implementing, and managing *any new features, apps, or modules* that GHL releases in the future is strictly included in this role and your current pay structure. You are our resident GHL Master; managing the platform's evolution is the job.

 

The Visionary & Tech Partner Dynamic:  We are the visionaries. We will often hand you the initial AI blueprints, the base code, and the funnel concepts. Your job is to take those pieces, put them together, and make them flawless.



Active Lead Nurturing & Inbox Management:  Monitor the GHL central inbox. You will personally text and
 the incoming leads, answering their questions and expertly guiding them to book.



Lifetime Client Retention & Newsletters:  Your job does not end when a lead closes. You will build and manage continuous follow-up sequences, design and send out newsletters, and keep past clients deeply engaged. You are responsible for ensuring our pipelines are always taken care of so that we keep our clients for a lifetime and generate repeat sales.



Pipeline Tracking:  Ensure every single lead—from brand-new prospects to past clients—is tagged correctly and moving through the appropriate pipeline efficiently so we know exactly who we need to call.



Schedule & Hours:



35 Hours Per Week.





Mandatory Weekends:** Because our event venues, retreats, and real estate clients are highly active over the weekend, Saturday and Sunday availability is strictly mandatory.



Mandatory Daily Tea
etings:** You are required to attend a 1 to 2-hour video tea
eting **every single day that you work . These are critical, daily syncs where we discuss campaign performance, new visions, and upcoming system builds.



Flexible Weekdays:** The rest of your hours will vary throughout the weekdays depending on inbox volume, giving you flexibility outside of the mandatory meetings.



Compensation (Escalating Base + Performance + KPI Bonuses):**

This role is designed to reward loyalty, system accuracy, and lead conversion. We provide guaranteed raises as you prove your reliability, and all base hourly payroll is processed strictly on Fridays.



The 1-Week Paid Trial:** We are hiring within the next week. Your first week will be a paid trial at **$4.00 / Hour** to ensure you are the perfect fit for our ecosystem.



The Escalating Base Pay:**

* **Month 1 (Including Trial):* $4.00 / Hour

* **Month 2:* $6.00 / Hour

* **After 90 Days:* $8.00 / Hour PLUS a $30/month stipend strictly to cover your local HMO health insurance costs.





Long-Term Loyalty Bonus:** After 12 months  of continuous, successful employment, you will receive a full  13th-month pay bonus.



Monthly KPI Bonuses:** You will receive additional  bonuses at the end of each month if your systems hit our expected lead-generation goals.

 Uncapped Commissions:** You earn bonuses for every lead you nurture that successfully closes/books!

 Example 1: You set up a roofing funnel and work the inbox. When we close and collect payment from the roof lead, you get $25

* *Example 2:  You build a retreat funnel and text the interested leads. When a lead pays and books the retreat, you get **$50

* *Example 3: You manage the funnel for our energy therapy and hypnosis sessions. Every session booked gets you an extra $10.







Who You Are:



Education / Certification Required:** You MUST hold a formal degree OR an official GoHighLevel Certification to be considered for this role.

 You have verifiable, hands-on experience building advanced funnels, fixing webhooks, managing custom code, and handling A2P compliance inside GoHighLevel.



Your written English is exceptional, and you know how to text/email leads in a friendly, professional, and persuasive way.



 You are an independent thinker. You don't wait to be told exactly what to do step-by-step.



How to Apply:

If you are ready to take ownership of our pipelines and grow with us, please apply with the following:



1. Proof of your degree or GoHighLevel certification.

2. Video Submission: A link to a short Loom video (or similar screen recording) showing us a specific workflow, campaign, or funnel you personally built within GoHighLevel. Walk us through the backend logic and how it functions.

3. A brief summary of your GHL experience (specifically with webhooks, automations, and domain/compliance setups).

4. An example of how you would follow up via text message with a lead who opted in for a "Wellness Retreat" but hasn't booked their spot yet.

5. Put the phrase "Love and Light Engine" in the subject line of your application so we know you read these instructions completely.

Compensation

This is a 100% pay-per-posted-video position.

You are paid for every approved video that is successfully edited and posted.

The more videos you complete, the more you earn.

Your monthly income is based entirely on your production output.

Typical monthly earnings range from approximately $480 to $1,000+, with higher earnings available for editors who consistently produce more content while maintaining quality.

There are no limits on your earning potential. High-performing editors who consistently produce quality work have the opportunity to increase their monthly income as content volume grows.

* Can edit long-form YouTube videos

* Can create engaging short-form clips

* Is fast and reliable

* Communicates quickly

* Pays attention to detail

* Can follow systems and instructions

* Enjoys repetitive, high-volume work

* Wants long-term, consistent work

* Wants to grow with a rapidly expanding company



Editing Style

Our editing style is simple and efficient.

We primarily use:

* Clean cuts

* Zoom-ins

* Captions

* Graphics when needed

* B-roll when appropriate

* Retention-focused pacing

We do not expect complicated cinematic edits or heavy visual effects.

Speed and consistency are more valuable than flashy editing.



Software Requirements

Experience with at least one of the following:

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* CapCut

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

This is more than an editing job.

Every day you'll work with real business content covering:

* Sales

* Negotiation

* Marketing

* Entrepreneurship

* Real estate investing

You'll gain exposure to real client conversations and business strategies while helping build one of the fastest-growing content operations in our industry.

As our media department expands, high performers will have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and leadership roles.

Content Editor ? Senior Content Operator ? Team Lead ? Head of Media

As content production increases, so does your opportunity to earn more.

We're hiring 1–3 more editors to join our growing media team.

If you're dependable, enjoy producing content at a high volume, and want your income to grow based on your output rather than the number of hours you work, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Amazon FBA Logistics & Supplier Manager (UK Marketplace)
description:
We are Bergmis, a UK-based Amazon FBA business selling home and kitchen products on Amazon UK. We're looking for an experienced Logistics & Supplier Coordinator to own the day-to-day communication between our team, our suppliers in China, and our freight forwarders.



This is a part-time role (approx. 20 hours/week) with the clear intention of growing into full-time as we scale. You'll work directly with our operations lead and take real ownership, not just tick boxes.



What you'll do:



- Manage daily
 and WeChat/WhatsApp communication with our China-based suppliers: purchase order confirmations, production updates, sample requests and issue resolution.

- Chase and track production timelines, flag delays early and keep our internal schedule up to date.

- Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders: bookings, documents (CI, PL, telex), customs queries and delivery into Amazon UK fulfilment centres.

- Create and track FBA inbound shipments in Seller Central and resolve check-in discrepancies

- Schedule and follow up on pre-shipment inspections

- Keep our order and shipment trackers accurate and current at all times



What we need from you:



- 2+ years' experience in Amazon FBA logistics or supply chain, specifically working with China suppliers and shipping into Amazon UK or EU

- Confident, professional written English. You will be the voice of our company to suppliers, so this is non-negotiable

- Comfortable juggling multiple orders, suppliers and shipments at once without dropping details

- Calm under pressure. Delayed shipments and supplier problems are part of this job, and we need someone who solves them rather than panics

- Working knowledge of Seller Central (Send to Amazon workflow), incoterms (FOB, DDP) and standard shipping documents

Reliable internet and availability with at least 3 hours' overlap with UK business hours



Good to have:



-Experience with Sellerboard or similar tools

- Mandarin (helpful but not required)



To show us you read this far, please start your application with the word "Anchor" and include one example of a supplier or shipping problem you solved and how.

description:
I run a boutique talent management and content monetisation agency based in the UK. We represent reality TV personalities and influencer talent on brand partnerships and
 content 
. Small team, growing fast, no corporate layers.



I'm the founder and I need someone working directly alongside me to run the day-to-day operations. Deal management, brand outreach, content coordination, and keeping everything moving without being told.



This is not a data entry role. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. I need someone who thinks commercially, writes beautifully, and takes action before I've finished thinking about it. You are super detail oriented and genuinely like being part of an organised system.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



— Managing the brand deal pipeline from first outreach through to signed contract and payment

— Drafting pitch
s to major UK and international brands

— Following up with brands and chasing responses (persistently but professionally)

— Coordinating content schedules across multiple talent social media pages

— Managing freelancers — editors, content creators - making sure they deliver on time

— Keeping our CRM/deal tracker updated and accurate

— Chasing invoices and tracking payments

— Spotting opportunities I haven't seen- a brand launching a campaign, a talent 
nt worth capitalising on





WHO YOU ARE



— Your written English is flawless. Not "good"  flawless. You'll be
ing brand managers at Nike, L'Oréal, and major UK retailers on my behalf.

— You understand influencer marketing, talent management, or PR. You know what a brand deal looks like and how the process works.

— You are proactive. If something needs doing, you do it. You don't send me a message asking if you should do the obvious thing. You do not wait to be actioned and you never just write me a message with Chat GPT that something is under control and then don't do it.

— You're organised and detail-oriented. Nothing falls through the cracks.

— You're comfortable working UK hours or with significant overlap.

— You genuinely find the creator economy interesting — this isn't just another VA job to you.





WHAT THIS ISN'T



— This is not a role where you'll be given a step-by-step checklist every morning

— This is not social media posting or graphic design

— This is not suitable if you need constant supervision or hand-holding

—This is not a role where you just sit around, you are passionate and excited to do a good job.



HOURS AND PAY



15-20 hours per week to start, with room to grow as the agency scales. Fixed monthly retainer plus commission on deals you help close ( this can seriously boost your income)





HOW TO APPLY



Do not send me a generic cover letter. Do not send me a CV. I need to see how you actually think.



Instead, do this:



1. Go to 
 and pick ONE talent from the roster.

2. Find a real UK brand that would be a genuine fit for that talent.

3. Write me the 3-4 line pitch
 you would send to that brand's marketing team. Keep it short, sharp, and professional.

4. Send me a 60-second voice note (WhatsApp or audio file) introducing yourself — who you are, what you've done, and why this role is right for you.



If you skip any of these steps, I won't read your application.



I'm looking for one person. The right person. If that's you, I'll know fast and can't wait to work with you.

title: Performance Video Editor - High-Retention Ads + AI Video
description:
We are hiring a performance video editor for DTC ecommerce paid-social ads.



This is not a general editing role. We need someone who can do two things exceptionally well:



1. Edit ads that stop the scroll and hold attention. You understand first-frame clarity, hooks, pacing, curiosity, proof, open loops, pattern changes, and how to use retention data to improve the next version.

2. Create usable video with AI. This means generating or substantially transforming video scenes, iterating when outputs fail, repairing weak generations, and integrating AI footage into a finished ad. Using ChatGPT only for scripts, captions, or ideas does not count as AI-video experience.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Edit 15-60 second ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, and similar platforms

- Turn UGC, product footage, images, scripts, reviews, and raw assets into direct-response ads

- Create genuinely different hook, opening, pacing, and creative-angle variations

- Generate or modify scenes, B-roll, motion, voice, and product visuals with AI

- Combine AI-generated and real footage so the finished ad feels coherent and believable

- Review performance data and identify where and why viewers stop watching

- Recommend the next creative test instead of waiting for exact editing instructions

- Produce 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 versions when required



REQUIREMENTS



- A portfolio containing short-form paid-social or direct-response ads

- Strong understanding of hooks, hold rate, pacing, sales structure, proof, and calls to action

- Real experience creating AI-generated or AI-transformed video

- Ability to explain why an edit should improve viewer behavior

- Ability to turn one concept into meaningful test variations, not cosmetic changes

- Fast, proactive, organized, and comfortable solving unclear creative problems

- Reliable computer and internet connection



Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut experience is useful. The exact software matters less than the quality and performance judgment visible in your work.



YOU ARE PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF



- Your portfolio is mainly long-form YouTube videos, podcasts, weddings, gaming montages, or cinematic reels with no paid-social work

- You choose edits because they look impressive but cannot connect them to the hook, message, or retention

- Your only AI experience is scripts, prompts, automatic captions, or static images

- You accept the first AI generation without iteration or cleanup

- You need detailed instructions for every cut and do not suggest stronger options

- You cannot identify exactly what you personally created in your portfolio



COMPENSATION



$800-$1,200/month depending on experience and paid-test performance, with performance bonuses available.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter and do not begin with a greeting.



Your first line must be exactly:



RETENTION | [First Name] | [Main AI Video Tool] | [Minutes Spent Applying]



Then answer all five sections below.



1. PERFORMANCE PROOF



Send links to your two strongest short-form paid-social ads. For each, state:



- Product and platform

- Exactly what you personally created

- The hook used

- One performance result you genuinely saw, such as hook rate, hold rate, watch time, CTR, CPA, or ROAS



Do not invent metrics. Saying you did not have access to performance data is acceptable.



2. OWNERSHIP AND SELF-CRITIQUE



Choose the weaker of your two examples. Give the exact timestamp where viewers are most likely to leave, explain why, and state the first change you would test.



3. AI-VIDEO PROOF



Send one example containing footage or motion you generated or substantially transformed with AI. Static AI images, scripts, and automatic captions alone do not qualify.



Explain:



- Which parts were AI-generated or AI-modified

- The tools used

- What the first output got wrong

- What you changed to make it usable

- How you integrated it into the finished edit



If possible, include both a failed output and the improved result. Do not include confidential client material.



4. RETENTION JUDGMENT



An ad has a strong first-three-second hook rate, but most viewers leave between seconds 4 and 6. People who reach the product demonstration usually watch to the end and click at a strong rate.



In six bullets or less:



- Give the three most likely structural causes

- State what you would inspect first in the timeline

- State the first test you would run

- State what information you would ask us for before deciding



Do not answer with faster cuts, more captions, or trending music.



5. LOGISTICS



State:



- Requested hourly rate or monthly salary

- Part-time or full-time preference

- Current availability and earliest start date

- Computer specifications and primary editing software

- Two time windows for a live screen-share interview



End your application with this exact sentence:



I understand that an AI-written script is not AI video.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid editing work sample using the same source-asset pack. The final stage includes a short screen-share review of the submitted project.



Applications that do not follow this format will not be considered.

A growing US-based construction and field services company is looking for a highly organised and proactive Executive Assistant & Financial Administration Virtual Assistant to support its CFO. This role is designed to take ownership of high-volume inbox management and day-to-day financial administration, allowing the CFO to focus on forecasting, reporting, and strategic financial planning instead of administrative tasks.



If you're someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, enjoys improving systems, and has strong bookkeeping and executive support experience, we'd love to hear from you.



Hours & Setup

Full-time, Monday to Friday (40 hours/week)

Split shift to align with US Eastern Time (approximately 5–6 hours during the US morning, with the remaining hours completed later in the day)

Fully remote

Start date: As soon as possible



What You'll Be Doing



Executive Inbox Management

Take ownership of the CFO's inbox, managing approximately 200–300
s per day

Sort, categorise, and prioritise
s by urgency and action required

Learn the CFO's communication style and response patterns to confidently handle routine correspondence

Draft professional
 responses for review or send independently once trained

Flag urgent issues requiring immediate attention while filtering out low-value notifications

Coordinate with internal tea
mbers, vendors, and external stakeholders



Financial Administration & Bookkeeping

Support daily bookkeeping activities using QuickBooks Online

Assist with account reconciliations

Review invoices before they're issued to ensure billing accuracy

Monitor collections and accounts receivable-related communications

Support financial record accuracy and maintain organised documentation

Coordinate with the finance team on day-to-day administrative tasks



Dispatch & Operations Support

Monitor incoming dispatch and work order notifications

Transfer completed jobs from the dispatch platform into QuickBooks Online

Ensure field technicians have accurate job information for time tracking

Help maintain smooth communication between operations and finance



Reporting & Administrative Support

Prepare and maintain Excel reports covering operational and financial performance

Reinstate and maintain weekly internal status reports

Assist with forecasting preparation and reporting support

Track recurring administrative tasks and important deadlines



Vendor & Insurance Administration

Assist with insurance renewals and policy comparisons

Coordinate broker communications and required documentation

Manage vendor applications and administrative paperwork

Track renewal dates and follow up on outstanding requirements



What We're Looking For

Experience

Minimum 2 years' experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Bookkeeper, or Finance VA

Previous experience supporting business owners, executives, or finance leaders

Experience managing high-volume
 inboxes

Background in bookkeeping or financial administration

Experience in construction, trades, field services, or similar industries is highly desirable



Technical Skills

QuickBooks Online experience is essential

Strong Microsoft Excel skills

Microsoft Outlook or Gmail

Comfortable learning new job management and dispatch software

Strong computer literacy and ability to work across multiple systems simultaneously



Communication & Organisation

Excellent written English

Exceptional organisational skills

Able to prioritise competing tasks with minimal supervision

Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing invoices and financial information

Comfortable handling confidential financial and business information



You'll Thrive in This Role If You Are...

Calm under pressure and able to manage a high-volume inbox without becoming overwhelmed

Naturally organised and enjoy creating structure from busy workflows

Proactive and capable of working independently without constant direction

Detail-oriented and quick to spot inconsistencies or potential errors

A strong problem solver who takes initiative and suggests solutions

Trustworthy and professional when handling confidential financial information

Adaptable and comfortable working within evolving systems and processes

A team player who communicates effectively across multiple departments



Technology Stack

QuickBooks Online

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Excel

Dispatch Management Software (Dash)

Microsoft Office

AI tools such as ChatGPT (experience is an advantage)



Why This Role?



This isn't a traditional Executive Assistant role. You'll become the CFO's trusted right hand—bringing order to a busy inbox, supporting financial operations, improving processes, and helping the business operate more efficiently. Your work will directly free the CFO to focus on strategic planning and business growth while ensuring the day-to-day administration runs smoothly.

To be considered for this opportunity, please complete our application form and submit your introduction video:

title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support



Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



To Apply, please submit this form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1MQsTx8TQa



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing Every Day

Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention



You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements

Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have

Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Client Relationship Manager (AU Mortgage)
description:
Client Relationship Manager (AU Mortgage)



Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hours



**To Apply:** forms.cloud.microsoft/r/xawDceDUDU 





At Pierian, we help Australian mortgage brokers scale their businesses through highly skilled offshore teams, streamlined operations, and AI-powered solutions.



The Client Relationship Manager is responsible for managing long-term relationships with Australian mortgage broker clients after successful onboarding and implementation by the Transition Team. As the primary point of contact for your assigned clients, you will ensure their offshore operations continue to perform efficiently, service levels remain high, and business objectives are achieved. You will work closely with brokers and internal teams to monitor operational performance, resolve challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and support the continued growth of each client account. This role is ideal for experienced Australian mortgage professionals who combine strong operational knowledge with excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING EVERY DAY



Client Relationship Management

- Serve as the primary relationship manager for assigned Australian mortgage broker clients following transition to Business-As-Usual (BAU).

- Build trusted, long-term relationships through regular meetings, performance reviews, and proactive communication.

- Develop a deep understanding of each client's business, workflows, and operational priorities.

- Act as the primary escalation point for operational concerns and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams.



Operational Performance & Client Success

- Monitor client satisfaction, service quality, turnaround times, productivity, and operational performance.

- Review key performance metrics and provide recommendations to improve efficiency, quality, and service delivery.

- Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Leaders, Loan Processors, and Loan Analysts to ensure consistent service standards.

- Identify operational risks early and implement proactive solutions to maintain strong client relationships.

- Support clients in maximizing the value of their offshore teams and Pierian's operational solutions.



Business Growth & Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve client workflows and operational efficiency.

- Recommend additional resources or services based on client growth and business needs.

- Gather client feedback and collaborate with internal teams to continuously improve service delivery.

- Encourage adoption of operational best practices, technology, and AI-enabled workflows where appropriate.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with the Transition Manager to ensure a smooth handover from implementation to ongoing account management.

- Collaborate with Recruitment and Operations to support workforce planning and staffing requirements.

- Maintain accurate client records, meeting notes, action plans, and follow-up activities.





MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of experience in Australian mortgage operations, broker support, loan processing, loan analysis, or client - relationship management.

- Previous experience in one or more of the following roles:

Senior Mortgage Broker Assistant

Senior Loan Processor

Loan Analyst

Mortgage Operations Specialist

Team Leader

Operations Manager

Client Relationship Manager

Account Manager

Broker Support Lead

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

- Reliable internet connection and professional home office setup.





NICE TO HAVE

- Experience mentoring or leading mortgage operations teams.

- Experience creating SOPs, workflow documentation, or training materials.

- Experience managing offshore mortgage teams.

- Exposure to AI-powered workflow tools and business automation.

- Experience with Quickli, Podium, Simpology, MyCRM, or similar mortgage platforms.

- Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking.





EDUCATION

A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Management, or a related field is preferred but not required.

We value extensive Australian mortgage operations experience, leadership capability, and client relationship management above formal qualifications.





WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive base salary based on experience

- HMO coverage

- Leave credits

- 13th Month Pay

- Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months

title: Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research
description:
Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines (Metro Manila or Cebu preferred for talent network access)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a senior operations leader to take ownership of our CATI call floor — and to help shape what comes next. This is a senior, long-term partnership with a genuine strategic dimension, and the package reflects that:



• Lead the bridge to AI-assisted interviewing — the role includes contributing to a voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Detail below.

• Direct line to the COO — you’ll report straight to the Chief Operating Officer of TKW Research Group. No middle layers.

• Base retainer: ?130,000 – ?180,000 PHP per month, commensurate with seniority, paid in arrears.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.
