title: Dialler/Client Intake Specialist (Warm Leads Only) - Australian Claims
description:
We're growing and are looking for an outstanding Client Intake Specialist to become an important part of our team.



If you're confident speaking with people, enjoy helping others, are highly organised and want a role where your work genuinely makes a difference, we'd love to hear from you.



This is NOT a cold-calling role.



Every person you speak with has already contacted us or requested information about our services. Your job is to build rapport, understand their circumstances and guide them through the first step of becoming a client.



About Us

We are a growing Australian legal practice that helps people who can no longer work because of injury or illness access insurance benefits through their superannuation.

Many of our clients are going through one of the most difficult periods of their lives. Every conversation matters, which is why we're looking for someone who is professional, empathetic and genuinely enjoys helping people.

We believe in building long-term relationships with our tea
mbers by providing ongoing support, training and opportunities for growth.



What You'll Be Doing



Every day you'll be:

- Calling warm enquiries who have already requested information.

- Speaking with Australian clients over the phone.

- Building trust and making clients feel comfortable.

- Asking questions to understand their circumstances.

- Explaining our process clearly and professionally.

- Recording accurate notes in our CRM.

- Scheduling and completing follow-up calls.

- Sending client intake documentation when required.

- Working closely with our legal and administration teams.

- Submitting a daily end-of-day report.



Who Will Succeed In This Role?



You'll do well if you are someone who:

- Enjoys speaking with people.

- Communicates confidently in fluent English.

- Can build rapport quickly.

- Listens carefully before responding.

- Is organised and detail-oriented.

- Follows systems and processes consistently.

- Learns new software quickly.

- Takes ownership of your work.

- Can work independently while remaining part of a team.



Experience We Value



Experience in any of these areas is an advantage:

- Customer Service

- Client Support

- Appointment Setting

- Warm Lead Calling

- Virtual Assistance

- Insurance

- Medical Administration

- Legal Administration

- Australian Campaigns

- CRM Software

- Sales Support



If you don't have experience in every area but you're a fast learner with an excellent attitude, we'd still encourage you to apply.



Minimum Requirements



You will need:

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- A reliable computer.

- High-speed internet.

- A quiet, professional workspace.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours.

- The ability to learn new systems and follow established processes.



We want this to be a long-term role, not just another job.



What you'll receive:

- Full-time remote employment.

- Warm leads only—no cold calling.

- Structured training and ongoing coaching.

- A supportive Australian team.

- Weekly payments via Wise.

- Paid Christmas shutdown leave (pro rata).

- Opportunities for career growth as our business expands.

- Meaningful work helping Australians during difficult times.



Success in this role is measured by:

- Professional communication.

- Quality conversations.

- Accurate CRM notes.

- Consistent follow-up.

- Reliability.

- Organisation.

- Attention to detail.

- Teamwork.



To show you've read this advertisement, the first line of your application must say: Warm Leads Dialler



How to Apply



Please submit:

1. Your latest resume.

2. A short cover letter telling us why you're the right person for this role.

3. A Loom video answering the following question:



Imagine you're calling someone who has already enquired about making an insurance claim. They sound nervous and aren't sure whether they want to continue.



How would you introduce yourself and help them feel comfortable speaking with you?



Please answer naturally, as though you're speaking directly to a real client. We are not looking for a memorised script—we want to hear your communication style, confidence, empathy and ability to build rapport.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Remote Legal Admin – Australian Claims
description:
Important: Read This Before Applying



There are strict instructions on how to apply for this position. If you do not follow the instructions exactly, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.



Your application must include all of the following:



1. Your latest resume.

2. A covering letter explaining why you believe you are suitable for this role.

3. An original Loom video answering the application question at the bottom of this post.



The Loom video must be recorded specifically for this application. Do not send a generic Loom that you have used for other jobs. Do not copy a script or read from a template.



We want to hear how you naturally communicate in English and assess your ability to explain information clearly and professionally.



If your application is missing anything, or if your Loom appears copied, scripted, AI-generated, old or generic, you may not be considered.



About The Role



TPD Matters is looking for a reliable, highly organised and detail-focused Remote Legal Admin to join our Australian legal support team.



We assist clients with Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) claims. Many of our clients are dealing with injuries, illnesses and difficult personal circumstances, so professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy and clear communication are extremely important. This is a hands-on administrative and legal support role focused on helping client files progress efficiently.



You will maintain client files, manage documents and correspondence, complete follow-ups, communicate with clients and external organisations, and ensure tasks are properly recorded and actioned. This role requires someone who takes ownership of their work. You must be able to identify what needs to be done, follow established processes, complete tasks accurately and report back clearly.



What You Will Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:

- Updating and maintaining client files, records, notes, tasks and follow-ups.

- Assisting with the progression of client matters through the required administrative stages.

- Managing incoming documents, correspondence and client information accurately.

- Saving
s, documents and correspondence to the correct client file.

- Ensuring important correspondence is actioned rather than simply received or filed.

- Creating and updating tasks, reminders and next steps so that required actions are not missed.

- Contacting clients to obtain information, documents, signatures or updates when required.

- Contacting superannuation funds, insurers and other relevant organisations to request information and follow up outstanding matters.

- Following up outstanding requests consistently and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.

- Preparing, sending and following up documents and forms as directed.

- Maintaining accurate and detailed file notes after calls,
s and other actions.

- Working within Actionstep and other CRM/client management systems.

- Communicating clearly with the Sydney team and remote team.

- Following SOPs, checklists, training materials and written instructions.

- Reporting clearly on completed work, outstanding tasks, blockers and matters requiring escalation.

- Handling confidential and sensitive client information carefully and professionally.

- Assisting with other legal administration and file-management tasks as directed.



Performance Expectations

This is a detail-focused and accountability-driven role.



Your success will be measured by the quality and accuracy of your work, your ability to progress tasks efficiently, follow-up consistency, file and CRM accuracy, communication, responsiveness and your ability to follow established processes.



We expect you to:

- Complete assigned tasks accurately and within required timeframes.

- Keep client files, notes, documents and tasks organised and up to date.

- Follow up outstanding matters without needing repeated reminders.

- Record actions clearly so another tea
mber can immediately understand what has occurred and what needs to happen next.

- Properly action incoming
s and correspondence rather than leaving them unattended.

- Escalate problems, delays or uncertainty instead of allowing a matter to sit unresolved.

- Be available and responsive during working hours.

- Communicate clearly when a task is completed, delayed or requires assistance.

- Follow SOPs and instructions consistently.



Accuracy is extremely important. Our team works with legal matters and sensitive client information, so incomplete notes, missed follow-ups, incorrectly saved documents or unactioned correspondence can affect the progression of a client’s matter.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent written and good spoken English.

- Can comfortably work with CRM systems, client files, folders, documents and task lists.

- Is highly organised, reliable and detail-focused.

- Communicates professionally and naturally with Australian clients and stakeholders.

- Has strong administrative skills and can manage multiple files, tasks and follow-ups without losing track of important actions.

- Takes ownership of assigned work and follows tasks through to completion.

- Is confident making professional outbound calls when follow-up is required.

- Is comfortable communicating with clients, insurers, superannuation funds and other organisations.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (AEST/AEDT) Sydney time, unless otherwise agreed.

- Can work independently while still reporting back clearly to the team.

- Is responsive and reliable during working hours.

- Understands the importance of confidentiality when handling sensitive client and legal information.

- Is willing to learn and adapt to Australian legal and administrative processes.

- Experience That Will Be Highly Regarded



Experience in any of the following will be viewed favourably:

- Legal administration.

- Legal assistant or legal clerk work.

- CRM or case-management systems.

- Claims administration or claims support.

- Insurance administration.

- Personal injury or disability claims.

- Client services.

- Australian legal, insurance or professional services businesses.

- Document-heavy administrative roles.

- Roles involving regular client and stakeholder follow-up.



Previous experience with Actionstep is an advantage but is not required. We are more interested in your ability to learn systems quickly, follow processes accurately and maintain high-quality records.



What We Offer

- Full-time remote work with a growing Australian business.

- A structured role with clear SOPs, training and support.

- Training in our systems and processes.

- A stable long-term opportunity for the right person.

- Meaningful work supporting clients who may be going through difficult circumstances.

- Weekly payment in arrears through Wise after onboarding.

- Two weeks of prorated paid time off during the Christmas closedown period.

- Selected Australian public holidays recognised in line with company policy.

- Opportunity to develop strong experience in Australian legal administration and claims processes.

- Long-term opportunity for someone who performs well, communicates clearly and consistently follows the process.

- Application Question For Your Loom Video



Record a short Loom video answering the following scenario:



"Imagine you are assisting with an Australian client’s legal matter. You notice that information requested from an external organisation has still not been received, and the client is also waiting for an update.

Talk us through what you would do next and explain how you would communicate with the client, the external organisation and your internal team."



Please answer naturally, in your own words. Do not read from a script, copy an answer from the internet or use a template.



Final Instruction

To show that you have read the full advert, start the first line of your application with this exact phrase:



TPD Matters Admin



If you do not include this exact phrase at the start of your application, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.

title: Lead Qualifier / Appointment Setter — US Marketing Agency (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We're a Houston-based marketing agency that runs paid advertising campaigns for HVAC companies (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning). Our ads generate leads, homeowners who need AC repair, furnace installation, maintenance, etc. — and we need someone to qualify those leads and book appointments for our clients' sales teams.



This is not cold calling. These are warm/hot leads who already raised their hand by filling out a form or clicking on an ad.



What You'll Do

- Respond to incoming leads quickly (speed-to-lead is everything)

- Call, text, and follow up with warm leads to qualify them

- Ask the right questions to determine if they're a good fit (homeowner? timeline? budget? type of service needed?)

- Book qualified leads onto our clients' calendars

- Update and manage lead records inside our CRM (GoHighLevel or similar)

- Follow structured follow-up sequences — no lead falls through the cracks

- Track your numbers and report on daily activity (calls made, appointments set, show rates)



Who You Are

- Perfect English - spoken AND written. You will be calling US-based homeowners. Your English must be clear, natural, and confident on the phone. No heavy accent. This is the #1 requirement.

- Proven appointment setting or inside sales experience - you've done this before. You can handle objections, build rapport quickly, and move a conversation toward a booked appointment.

- Tech-comfortable - you can navigate CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), calendar tools (Calendly, Google Calendar), and aren't afraid to figure out new platforms on your own.

- Reliable and available 9 AM – 6 PM Central Time, Monday–Friday — no exceptions. This is a strict US business hours role.

- Self-motivated - you don't need to be micromanaged. You see a lead come in, you pick up the phone.





Bonus (not required, but a plus)

- Experience in home services lead gen (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar, etc.)

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel and any other CRMs

- Experience with speed-to-lead workflows

- Basic Spanish is a plus (many homeowners in Houston are Spanish-speaking)



To Apply

Please include:

1. A short loom video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself in English, tell us about your appointment setting experience and why you're a good fit. This is required. Applications without a loom recording will not be reviewed.

2. Your experience with CRMs (which ones, how long)

3. Your current availability and confirmation you can work 9 AM – 6 PM Central Time

4. Please include your answer in your loom video: A homeowner fills out a form saying they need AC repair, but when you call them they say "I was just looking, I'm not really interested." What do you say?



Thanks!

We are looking for an experienced Sales Support & Zoho CRM Assistant to support our Perth-based Sales Manager with CRM management, quote data entry, sales follow-up, and client communication.



## About the Role



This role is for someone with a high level of experience using **Zoho CRM** and strong previous experience in a **sales support, sales administration, customer service, or sales coordination role**.



You will help keep our sales process organised by updating Zoho CRM, entering quote details, moving sales opportunities through the pipeline, and following up quotes with clients by phone and
.



This is not a basic data entry role. We need someone who understands how sales pipelines work, can manage CRM information properly, can think ahead, and can help make sure no lead, quote, or follow-up is missed.



You do not need to be a qualified surveyor, but you must be confident working inside a sales process, managing CRM data, communicating clearly with clients, and supporting a busy Perth-based Sales Manager.



Strong written and spoken English is most important, we can train other areas.



## Key Responsibilities



* Support the Perth-based Sales Manager with daily sales administration

* Update and manage leads, contacts, deals, quotes, notes, and follow-up tasks in Zoho CRM

* Move sales opportunities through the correct Zoho CRM stages

* Complete accurate data entry for quotes and client information

* Follow up quotes by phone and

* Record all client updates and sales activity clearly in Zoho CRM

* Help ensure no leads, quotes, or follow-ups are missed

* Support the sales pipeline with accurate reporting and clean CRM data

* Identify missing information, incomplete records, or follow-up issues

* Communicate clearly with clients and internal tea
mbers

* Follow sales processes and instructions carefully

* Help improve sales administration processes where possible



## What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who has:



* High-level Zoho CRM experience

* Previous experience in sales support, sales administration, sales coordination, customer service, or a similar sales role

* Strong understanding of sales pipelines, lead stages, follow-ups, and deal movements

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Confidence speaking with clients by phone

* Strong attention to detail

* Accurate data entry skills

* Good problem-solving skills

* The ability to work independently and manage recurring tasks

* A self-starter attitude

* Good computer skills

* Ability to work from home reliably

* Reliable internet and a suitable computer

* A professional, organised, and honest approach to work



## Required Experience



To be considered for this role, you must have experience with:



* Zoho CRM

* Sales administration or sales support

* CRM data entry and pipeline updates

* Client follow-up by phone or

* Sales processes, leads, quotes, deals, or opportunities

* Remote work or online systems

* Clear written and spoken English communication



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following would be helpful:



* Working with Australian clients

* Quote follow-up

* Sales pipeline management

* Google Workspace

* Hubstaff or time tracking tools

* Property, construction, surveying, building, planning, or real estate industries



## Why Join Perth Surveying



You will be joining a growing surveying business with a clear focus on accuracy, service, and reliability.



Our team supports a wide range of property, construction, and development projects across Perth and Western Australia. We value good systems, honest communication, and people who take pride in doing their work properly.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your updated CV / resume

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Details of your Zoho CRM experience

4. Details of your sales support, sales admin, customer service, or sales role experience

5. Examples of how you have used a CRM to manage leads, deals, quotes, or follow-ups

6. A short explanation of your phone communication experience

7. Confirmation of your written and spoken English level (c1/C2/b1/b2 etc)

8. Your expected salary in PHP

9. A 1-minute video introduction 



## Before We Proceed



Please also answer the following questions in your application.



### 1) Zoho CRM Experience



Please explain your Zoho CRM experience in detail.



Include what you have used Zoho CRM for, such as leads, deals, contacts, quotes, tasks, workflows, reporting, or pipeline management.



### 2) Sales Experience



Please explain your previous sales support, sales admin, customer service, or sales role experience.



Tell us what your responsibilities were and how you supported the sales process.



### 3) Phone Communication



Are you comfortable calling clients to follow up quotes?



Please explain your experience making client calls.



### 4) PC / Laptop and Internet



Please provide your computer specifications, including CPU, RAM, and storage.



Please also include a recent internet speed test result.



### 5) Current Work or Side Jobs



Are you currently employed, freelancing, or doing any side jobs?



We are open to this, but we expect transparency so we understand your schedule properly.



### 6) Hubstaff



Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking?



### 7) Working Hours



Can you work Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm Philippines time?



### 8) Expected Salary



Please confirm your expected salary in PHP.



### 9) English Level



Please confirm your English level and your confidence with both written and spoken English.



### 10) Attention to Detail Check



To confirm you have read this advert properly, please answer this question:



**What are the three main ways this role supports the Perth-based Sales Manager?**



Applications that do not answer this question may not be reviewed.



## Additional Fit Questions



Please also answer the following questions. These are important and will help us understand how you think, work, and solve problems.



### 11) Self-Starter Example



Tell us about a time when you saw a problem at work and fixed it without waiting to be asked.



What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?



### 12) Zoho CRM Problem-Solving



Imagine you open Zoho CRM and notice that several quotes have no follow-up date, some deals are in the wrong stage, and client notes are incomplete.



What steps would you take to clean this up and make sure nothing is missed?



### 13) Quote Follow-Up Scenario



A client was sent a quote five days ago but has not replied.



What would you say when calling them, and what information would you record in Zoho after the call?



### 14) Motivation for This Role



Why do you want this specific role with Perth Surveying?



Please do not give a generic answer. We want to understand what interests you about sales support, Zoho CRM, client follow-up, and working with a Perth-based team.



### 15) Working Without Constant Supervision



This is a remote role. Some days will require you to manage your own task list, follow up quotes, update Zoho, and keep the Sales Manager informed without being reminded.



How do you personally stay organised and accountable when working remotely?



### 16) Attention to Detail Scenario



You are entering quote information and notice that the client’s property address, phone number, or job details seem incomplete or possibly incorrect.



What would you do before moving the quote or lead forward?



### 17) Sales Mindset



This role is not a high-pressure sales role, but it does support the sales process.



What do you think makes a good quote follow-up call? How do you balance being helpful without being pushy?



### 18) Continuous Improvement



If you noticed a repeated issue in the sales process, such as missed follow-ups, unclear notes, or duplicate CRM records, how would you raise it with the Sales Manager?



### 19) English Communication Test



Please write a short follow-up
 to a client who has received a surveying quote but has not yet responded.



Keep it polite, professional, and clear.



### 20) Final Attention Check



In your own words, explain what this role is responsible for and why accurate Zoho CRM updates are important to Perth Surveying.



## Team Context



Perth Surveying has tea
mbers in Australia and the Philippines. Our team works remotely and relies on clear communication, accurate systems, and honest people.



We are looking for someone reliable, organised, experienced with Zoho CRM, and confident supporting a sales process.



Every role matters. The most important thing for us is building a happy, capable team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.



Thank you, and we look forward to your application.

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. This isn't a role for someone who just follows a script; we need a problem-solver who understands the "why" behind Amazon’s rules and knows how to navigate them effectively. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.



Key Responsibilities

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly. 



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.



Operational Support: General administrative tasks related to the Amazon storefront to ensure "everything is just handled."



The Ideal Candidate

The "Amazon Veteran": You’ve been inside Seller Central long enough to know that "The Rules" and "How things actually work" are often two different things.



Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.



English Fluency: Excellent written English is a must for both customer service and drafting persuasive appeals to Amazon.



Technical Requirements

Proven experience with Amazon Seller Central (specifically Account Health and Case Logs).



Experience handling "difficult" compliance or reinstatement issues is a major plus.



Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

description:
Brewer Medical Solutions is a US company that calibrates and repairs hearing-testing equipment for medical clinics. We are hiring 5–10 experienced cold callers to phone audiology clinics, ENT offices, pediatric clinics, and school districts across California, Nevada, and Arizona.



These are business-to-business calls to office staff during US business hours. No consumer calling, no selling pressure tactics. Your job on each call:





Reach the office manager or decision-maker

Find out when their testing equipment is next due for calibration

 accurately

Accurate, careful data entry — we check

 is fine, 60–90 seconds) where you: introduce yourself, describe your cold calling experience, and read this script line naturally: "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Brewer Medical Solutions on a recorded line. Your responsibilities may include:



- Opening assigned real estate agents’ Instagram profiles

- Confirming that you have located the correct person and account

- Following accounts when instructed

- Liking appropriate recent posts

- Leaving relevant and natural comments using our guidelines

- Viewing and engaging with Instagram Stories

- Sending approved initial direct messages

- Completing scheduled follow-up messages and inbox bumps

- Accurately recording completed actions in our CRM

- Flagging inactive, fake, incorrect, or questionable accounts

- Checking for possible duplicate outreach

- Avoiding current clients and people already contacted by another company account

- Following daily activity limits and account-safety procedures

- Providing a short end-of-shift update

- Completing additional administrative or lead-management tasks as the position grows



All Instagram activity must be completed manually.



We do not use bots, mass-messaging software, or unauthorized Instagram automation.



You will receive training and written procedures. However, you must be willing to think carefully, ask questions, and avoid making assumptions.



Example of the Judgment We Expect



The CRM may instruct you to contact an Instagram account, but you might notice that:



- The person may already be a client

- Another Beholden Visuals account may have already contacted them

- The Instagram handle may be incorrect

- The account may no longer belong to a real estate professional

- The person may not be located in our service area

- The appropriate post to engage with may not be obvious



In these situations, you should stop, document what you found, and ask for clarification instead of guessing.



We would rather answer a question than correct an avoidable mistake.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Backup internet access or a clear backup plan

- A reliable smartphone capable of running the current Instagram app

- A dependable computer or laptop

- A functioning webcam and microphone for Zoo
etings

- The ability to follow a documented process

- The ability to work independently without constant supervision

- Consistent weekday availability

- Comfort using a CRM or learning a new CRM

- A quiet environment for meetings and training

- The ability to receive feedback professionally

- The willingness to ask questions when instructions are unclear

- An interest in eventually growing into an eight-hour-per-day position



Previous experience with Instagram outreach, lead generation, data entry, CRM systems, real estate, or virtual assistance is helpful but not required.



Exceptional entry-level candidates who demonstrate strong judgment and attention to detail will still be considered.



This Position Is Not a Good Fit for You If



Please do not apply if you:



- Cannot consistently work from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

- Regularly multitask during meetings or training

- Have difficulty remaining attentive during Zoom calls

- Prefer to guess instead of asking questions

- Frequently overlook written instructions

- Submit generic applications without reading the complete posting

- Dislike repetitive and process-based work

- Plan to use bots or automated Instagram engagement tools

- Are already committed to another job during the same working hours

- Cannot attend required training or check-in meetings

- Frequently lose internet access without a backup plan

- Are not interested in taking on additional responsibilities over time



Starting Schedule



The position will begin with the following schedule:



Monday through Friday

8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

Four hours per day

Approximately 20 hours per week



This schedule follows Houston, Texas time throughout the year.



You must be fully available during the entire shift. You may not simultaneously work for another employer or client during these scheduled hours.



You must also be fully present during meetings and training. You may not complete unrelated work, communicate with other clients, or multitask during company meetings.



Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time



Our goal is to find someone who can grow with Beholden Visuals.



The position will begin at four hours per day. Depending on your performance and the needs of the company, your schedule may be expanded gradually toward eight hours per day.



Additional responsibilities may include:



- Managing larger daily outreach queues

- Completing follow-up communication

- Reviewing and organizing lead information

- Verifying Instagram accounts

- Maintaining CRM records

- Identifying duplicate or incorrect leads

- Assisting with lead research

- Helping document company processes

- Completing other administrative and marketing-support tasks



Additional hours are not guaranteed immediately. They will be based on available work, accuracy, reliability, communication, and your ability to successfully manage your current responsibilities.



Compensation and Performance Reviews



The starting rate is:



$5 USD per hour



At approximately 20 hours per week, this will generally equal around $100 USD per week, depending on the exact number of hours worked.



The selected candidate will begin with a paid trial period. Payments will be made weekly during the trial.



After successfully completing the trial, the regular payment schedule may move to twice per month.



Candidates who consistently demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a pay increase after a discussion and performance review.



Pay increases may happen relatively quickly for an exceptional candidate, but increases will be based on demonstrated performance and must be discussed and approved.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Accuracy

- Attention to detail

- Reliability

- Communication

- Ability to follow instructions

- Quality of CRM documentation

- Ability to learn from feedback

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Australian Accounting)
description:
We are Roger, a specialist hospitality and restaurant accounting firm. We support restaurants, cafes, bars and hospitality operators with bookkeeping, payroll, supplier administration, accounts payable, reconciliations and reporting. We also provide clients with weekly P&L dashboards, budget vs actual reporting, expense breakdowns, KPI trends and GST visibility.



We are looking for a Senior Bookkeeper with at least 5 years of Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. You must be very strong in Xero and comfortable using (or learning) Hubdoc daily.



This is not a junior role. We need someone accurate, reliable, responsive and confident working across multiple clients in a high-volume environment.



Key responsibilities



Reconcile bank feeds, credit cards, merchant facilities and payment platforms in Xero

Process supplier invoices daily through Hubdoc

Match bills, payments and receipts accurately

Investigate unreconciled items, duplicate entries and missing documents

Maintain accurate accounts payable records and supplier balances

Prepare clean, up-to-date Xero files for weekly reporting, BAS and month-end review

Prepare weekly accounts payable batch files

Complete weekly supplier statement reconciliations

Process payroll and complete payroll checks

Support weekly reporting and month-end close

Creating workflows which will be followed by future bookkeepers



Must-have requirements



Minimum 5 years of Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience

Strong Xero experience

BAS-ready bookkeeping experience

High attention to detail

Strong written English

Able to clean up messy files and identify errors quickly



Role details



Part-time role, currently 20 hours per week

Working hours: 10:00am to 2:00pm Philippines time

As we win additional clients, hours will increase by 5 hours per week per client

We expect this role to become full-time by July 2026

This role is intended to grow into a Bookkeeping Team Leader position managing junior bookkeepers



Who would suit this role

You have worked in Australian bookkeeping for several years, know Xero very well, understand reconciliations and accounts payable deeply, and can take ownership of your work without being micromanaged.



To apply, please answer the following



How many years of Australian bookkeeping experience do you have?

How many years have you used Xero?

Have you prepared BAS-ready files before?

Have you worked with hospitality, restaurant or cafe clients?

List your previous employers with contactable
s or Australian phone numbers to verify you experience

title: Accountant
description:

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly knowledgeable in cross-border tax matters, and capable of working independently.

Entity & Regulatory Management

-Strong experience with Xero

-Strong working knowledge of Philippine tax laws and regulations

-Familiarity with Australian taxation (income tax, GST, PAYG, BAS)

-Experience managing or supporting a Philippine corporate entity

-Proficiency in accounting software and payroll systems

-Experience with cross-border or multinational companies (preferred)

-Experience handling personal tax filings in addition to corporate tax (preferred)



What You Must Have

-Strong attention to detail and accuracy

-High level of integrity and confidentiality

-Excellent organisational and time-management skills

-Ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines

-Clear written and verbal communication skills

  / 
 )

• Own social media execution (Instagram and
).

 campaigns aligned with launches, promotions, and collaborations.

 channels operate smoothly with consistent execution and strong brand alignment.

This is an execution role, not a strategist role.



You will not set media strategy or make independent budget recommendations in year one.



We pay above typical market rate for this role because precision is non-negotiable. You will touch insertion orders and live client spend. Errors cost real money. If your work is not airtight, this is not the role for you.



You will build, launch, and optimize campaigns exactly as scoped, catch issues before they cost money, and own reporting.



If you want a hands-on role building real campaigns across search, social, and programmatic, and you take pride in never letting a detail slip, keep reading.



If you want to plan strategy or manage budgets independently, this is not the role, at least not yet.



Role Overview:



We are hiring a Digital Media Buyer to join the digital team at a 42 year old, family owned, full service advertising agency based in Dallas, Texas. You will work alongside two existing full time buyers. 



Spend authority is granted per campaign through an internal "campaign jacket" system. You will not set your own budgets, you will execute against the numbers you are given with precision.



If you have never built and launched paid campaigns hands on, this will not be a fit. This is not a training ground for someone new to Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager.

 and Instagram

- Set up and QA campaign tagging, pixels, UTM strings, and conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager

- Build and refine audiences for targeting

- Monitor pacing and spend daily, flag anything off track before it becomes a budget problem

- Run bid strategy adjustments and creative A/B tests

- Own monthly reporting in Google Analytics 4, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Track campaign jackets inside Basecamp, chase missing creative, and flag pending launches

- Follow the monthly cadence: campaign launch sprint in week one, optimization and mid month check ins in weeks two and three, full reporting sprint in week four

- If you spot a budget about to run without approval, or a campaign stuck waiting on creative, you catch it and flag it. You do not wait to be asked.



Required Experience:



- Minimum 3 to 4 years hands on building and launching paid media campaigns, with a track record of accurate spend management and zero costly errors

- Working experience in Google Ads (Search, Merchant Center, YouTube) and Meta Ads Manager 
, Instagram)

- Exposure to programmatic or DSP platforms such as Trade Desk, DV360, Basis, Orbit, or Simplifi

- Hands on experience with tagging, pixeling, UTM strings, and conversion tracking setup

- Experience handling insertion orders or live client budgets directly, not just campaign execution under someone else's oversight



Required Tools and Skills:



- Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Tag Manager

- Elevated Excel skills, comfortable beyond basic formulas, expert level a plus but not required

- Elevated PowerPoint skills for clean reporting decks

- Deep working knowledge of Google Analytics 4

- Comfort learning new proprietary systems, including Basecamp, quickly

- Excellent, clear spoken English. You will communicate directly with US based leadership daily and must be easily understood without repetition



How Success Is Measured:



- Attention to detail is airtight, no cent level mistakes on spend, insertion orders, or reporting

- Campaigns launch on time with no missed budgets

- Reporting is accurate, clean, and delivered on schedule

- Leadership does not have to chase you, you flag issues and ask for the next assignment when caught up

- You are trusted to grow into more responsibility over time



Work Requirements:



- Meticulous attention to detail above all else, this is the single most important trait for this role

- Highly responsive during US working hours, 9 AM to 6 PM CT

- Proactive, self starting working style, comfortable saying "I'm caught up, what's next"

- Comfortable executing against someone else's strategy, not setting your own in year one

- Quiet, professional home workspace

- Stable internet with backup

- Headset for daily meetings



Benefits:



- Paid vacation, holiday, and sick leave after probation

- Bi-monthly, tax free payroll via Wise

- Dedicated Workspark support and onboarding

- Long term, stable role with a US based team

- Real opportunity to grow into reporting ownership and beyond as you prove yourself

Apply here:

Good written English



Nice to Have



Experience with direct-response / DTC ecommerce ads

Understanding of ad angles, awareness stages, and message match

Basic motion graphics

Fast, direct communication (no bureaucracy)

Right now, a lot of that content lives in the real estate world — but the brand is expanding, and so is the range of topics we cover. We're looking for someone who can research and write across whatever niche we point them at, not just one lane.

About the role

We need a sharp, curious content strategist to become the research and writing engine behind our short-form video content. You'll spend your days studying what's winning in our target topics, cracking the code on why it works, and turning that insight into scroll-stopping hooks, scripts, and content plans that our team takes out and shoots with Logan.

This role is specialized and nuanced — you won't be expected to know our world on day one. We'll train you on the subject matter and our system. What we can't train is a sharp mind, a great ear for language, and the instinct for a story. If that's you, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do



Research top-performing content across our target niches — reels, shorts, and viral formats — and break down exactly why the best of it works

Spot emerging trends, hooks, and formats before they peak

Write compelling, high-retention hooks and full scripts for talking-head and short-form video

Build out content plans and shot outlines for shoot days, so Logan and the videographer walk in knowing exactly what to capture

Develop a deep working knowledge of each topic we cover (starting with real estate)

Keep the content pipeline organized and running like a machine



What we're looking for



Exceptional English — near-native comprehension and writing. You understand nuance, tone, and rhythm at a very high level. This is non-negotiable.

A genuinely sharp mind — you think critically, connect dots fast, and go deep instead of staying surface-level

Storytelling ability — you know how to make an idea land with a real audience

Strong organization — you can manage a pipeline and hit deadlines without being chased

Attitude, aptitude, and bandwidth — you're coachable, hungry to learn a specialized craft, and you have the capacity to take it on



Nice to have (but not required)



Background in journalism, copywriting, or content marketing

Curiosity about business, real estate, or entrepreneurship



A few practical notes



This is a remote, full-time role working U.S. business hours (8am–5pm CDT)

title: Senior Meta Media Buyer — DTC Supplement Brand
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC health & wellness supplement brand on Shopify. Meta is our primary paid channel and we're scaling aggressively — new creative tested daily, real budget behind it. We already have a creative machine producing a fresh ad batch every single day. What we need now is a media buyer who can take the wheel on the ad account completely so the founder can step out of day-to-day buying.



What You'll Own (this is a real seat, not a button-pusher role)



Full day-to-day management of our Meta ad account — testing, scaling, and killing

Running our ABO testing campaign (one ad set per daily creative batch) and graduating winners into scaling campaigns

Vertical + horizontal scaling: pushing budget on winners, iterating the ads that earn it, keeping ROAS stable as spend climbs

Daily account health: budget allocation, killing bleeders on trend (not panic), protecting top-spending feeder ads

Reading clickbased / incremental data and new-customer acquisition — not just blended ROAS

Feeding learnings back to the creative team: what angles, avatars, and formats Meta is rewarding

You MUST Have



Proven experience managing Meta accounts spending $20,000+/day (ideally more). This is a hard requirement — we will ask for proof.

A track record of scaling accounts, not just maintaining them — real before/after numbers

Deep understanding of the learning phase, scaling protocol (48–72h over target ? scale), CBO/ASC, and why accounts tank when you scale wrong

Fluency in soft metrics (CTR, CPC, CPM, cost-per-ATC, frequency) and attribution windows

Excellent written English and the discipline to check the account daily without being told

Nice to Have



DTC health / supplement experience

Experience with promo/sale campaign structures for peak periods

Familiarity with creative strategy (you don't have to write ads, but you should know a good one when you see it)

How to Apply — read carefully, this filters out 90% of applicants



Put "I SCALE PAST THE WALL" as the first line of your application. Applications without it get deleted unread.

Send the highest daily ad spend you've personally managed, and on what kind of brand/vertical.

Send at least one specific before/after result with real numbers — e.g. "Took Brand X from $3k/day at 1.8 ROAS to $18k/day at 2.4 ROAS over 6 weeks." Vague claims ("I'm great at scaling") get rejected.

Attach 1–2 screenshots of ad accounts you've managed (blur out brand names / sensitive info — I just want to see real spend and performance).

In 2–3 sentences: an account was hitting target ROAS for 3 days straight — walk me through exactly what you'd do next.

Serious, experienced buyers only. If you've genuinely run $20k+/day, this is a long-term seat with room to grow as we scale.

title: Senior Hospitality Bookkeeper (Xero Australian Accounting)
description:
We are Roger Financial, a specialist hospitality accounting firm working with Australian restaurants, cafes, bars and hospitality groups.



We handle bookkeeping, payroll, supplier administration, accounts payable, reconciliations and reporting, and we give our clients weekly P&L dashboards, budget vs actual reporting, expense breakdowns, KPI trends and GST visibility.



Our goal is to provide value to our clients in 3 ways:

1) We save them time

2) We keep them compliant with the ATO

3) We provide them with real insight into the performance of their business every week.



We are growing fast. Three months ago we had two clients. Today we have fourteen. This is a real chance to grow with us and step into a leadership role as we scale.



We just had our part-time bookkeeper leave us as they found our growth too overwhelming. We want someone who wants to stay with us for years & end up leading a team of bookkeepers inside 12 months.



HOW ARE WE GROWING SO FAST?



Here is what makes us different. We are half the cost of regular bookkeeping firms because AI is embedded in our business. We use Claude Code & Lovable heavily, with our bookkeepers expected to integrate this within their practice. You must be tech-savvy, AI friendly & serious about being on the forefront of bookkeeping.



While many firms have a 1:5 bookkeeper to client ratio, we aim for 1:15. We pay well, and are really lovely, BUT you must be efficient & on the ball.



This is a full-time and exclusive position. You work for Roger Financial only. Please do not try to juggle this job with another, it will be very obvious & it'll be a waste of both of our time.

We are looking for someone who wants this to be their career and takes it seriously.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



3 things that matter most to us are simple.



1) You must be an excellent bookkeeper, fast & familiar with Australian bookkeeping & Xero (!!).

You must know how to do double entry bookkeeping, reconcile sales invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts etc. Please do not apply unless you have at least 5 years experience (unless you absolutely tick other boxes). You also need to be tech and AI enabled. You want to use AI in your work, you are excited by it rather than threatened by it, and you are always looking for a faster and cleaner way to do things.



2) You must have real Australian hospitality bookkeeping experience. You must know how to reconcile sales & Lightspeed invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts (!!)

If you have not done hospitality books for Australian businesses, this is not the right role for you. Our clients love us because we don't just "do their books". We actually act as a partner for them, they trust us to tell them how they're going, is their COGS ratio too high, is their revenue supporting a healthy rent ratio etc. You need to understand hospitality bookkeeping. You must know how to reconcile sales & Lightspeed invoices against bank transactions in clearing accounts (!!)



3) We need a genuinely strong communicator who wants to be a leader of a team (!!).

You are confident, you have personality, you are not shy, and you are comfortable talking directly to clients and one day leading a team. As we grow, this role will turn into a Bookkeeping Team Leader position managing other bookkeepers, so we want someone who thinks about how to make the whole team better, not just their own desk.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Review and approve AI-categorised bills and invoices in Xero. The AI does the first draft, you check it, correct it and make it better.

- Reconcile bank feeds, credit cards, merchant facilities and payment platforms in Xero.

- Reconcile Square and Lightspeed sales back to bank settlements, netting off fees and clearing accounts correctly. This is a big part of hospitality work and needs to be second nature.

- Reconcile delivery platforms like Uber Eats and DoorDash to Xero.

- Process supplier invoices through Hubdoc and Dext where needed.

- Complete weekly supplier statement reconciliations and manage accounts payable, including preparing weekly ABA batch files.

- Process payroll in Xero, including payslips, STP, super and PAYG.

- Keep clean, BAS-ready books that are fully reconciled ahead of each quarter.

- Prepare weekly P&L and reporting, and communicate it directly to your clients with useful commentary.

- Own your client relationships. Own the work. You will have to chase suppliers constantly etc when onboarding clients.

- Record your processes in Loom and build workflows the rest of the team will follow. If you do something more than once, we want it documented.



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS



- Australian Hospitality bookkeeping experience. This is non-negotiable.

- At least 5 years of Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience, working with Australian companies.

- Strong Xero. You need to be genuinely expert here, not just familiar.

- Confident with the Australian hospitality software stack: Square, Lightspeed, Lightyear, Deputy, Tanda, Hubdoc and Dext.

- Square and Lightspeed reconciliation especially.

- BAS-ready bookkeeping with correct GST coding.

- A strong communicator with real personality. Confident on client calls and
s, not shy, and ready to lead a team.

- Tech and AI enabled. You want AI to be part of how you work.

- Full-time and exclusive. You are not working another job or running side clients. You are all in on this one.

- Degree in accounting or a related field.



HOSPITALITY KNOWLEDGE



You should understand, or be very keen to learn fast:

Cost of goods and what healthy food and beverage cost percentages look like (target 28 to 32%).

Labour cost percentage and what is acceptable (target 28 to 32%).

Prime cost, which is COGS plus labour, and why 60% is the line that matters.

Rent percentage benchmarks.

Square and Lightspeed POS reconciliation, matching sales reports to bank settlements and platform fees.

Clearing account reconciliation and how sales, fees and settlements net to zero.

Delivery platform reconciliation for Uber Eats, DoorDash and similar.



ROLE DETAILS



Full-time, 40 hours per week.

Working hours align with Australian business hours. 8am - 4pm PHT (10am - 6pm AEST). Do NOT work multiple jobs.

Fast-growing firm with real room to grow. This role is intended to become a Bookkeeping Team Leader position managing junior bookkeepers as we scale.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING.



Tell us why you match the 3 things that matter most to us. And why this job ad speaks to you. No generic, ChatGPT answers please. Also ensure you include your resume, Gmail & at least 2 contactable references.



SKILL REQUIREMENT

Accounts Reconciliations, Xero, Bookkeeping

title: Brand Film Director & AI Creative Systems Editor
description:
Read This Before You Apply

This is not a social media editing position.

This is not a content creator role.



This is not a "video editor" position.



We are building premium digital brands across multiple industries. Every project must establish credibility, communicate expertise, and create trust within seconds.



You'll create flagship website films, brand stories, product launches, recruiting campaigns, customer testimonials, corporate documentaries, executive interviews, and high-converting digital content.



If your work depends on templates, trendy transitions, or copying what is currently popular on social media, this role is not for you.



If your work consistently communicates emotion, trust, and authority through visual storytelling, we want to meet you.



Mission

Transform raw footage into premium brand assets that increase trust, engagement, and conversions.

Every project should answer three questions almost immediately:



Why should someone trust this company?

What makes this organization different?

Why should a customer choose them?

You will create films that become the centerpiece of websites, advertising campaigns, investor presentations, recruiting initiatives, and digital marketing systems.

What You'll Do

You'll receive footage from many different industries, including professional services, construction, healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, hospitality, education, technology, athletics, nonprofit organizations, and local businesses.

Your responsibility is not simply to edit footage.



Your responsibility is to discover and communicate the story hidden within it.



You will:



Review extensive libraries of raw video

Identify emotionally compelling moments

Build narrative through sequencing

Produce premium brand films

Create website hero videos

Develop customer testimonial videos

Produce executive interview content

Build recruiting and employer branding campaigns

Edit product launch videos

Produce social campaigns from flagship content

Deliver desktop, mobile, and social versions

Optimize all deliverables for performance across web platforms

Required Technical Expertise

Applicants should demonstrate mastery in most of the following.

Professional Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop (advanced proficiency)

Adobe Media Encoder

AI Production Workflow

You understand how AI accelerates professional production without replacing creative judgment.

Experience should include several of the following:



Adobe Firefly

Premiere AI

Runway

Topaz Video AI

AI object removal

AI stabilization

AI audio enhancement

AI scene detection

AI reframing

AI masking

AI transcript editing

AI workflow automation

Motion Design

Experience producing:

Logo animations

Motion graphics

Kinetic typography

Lower thirds

Interface animations

Infographics

Corporate presentation graphics

Cinematography Knowledge

You understand:

visual composition

lighting

movement

pacing

rhythm

color theory

shot selection

emotional sequencing

sound design

visual hierarchy

storytelling through editing

Brand Strategy

You understand the difference between:

A promotional video.



A corporate video.



A commercial.



A documentary.



A recruiting film.



A flagship brand story.



Every project should reinforce positioning, authority, and trust—not simply look attractive.



You Are Probably NOT a Fit If...

You primarily create:

TikTok edits

Instagram trend videos

Gaming montages

Wedding videos

Generic YouTube intros

Template-based reels

Fast-cut highlight compilations

We're looking for someone who builds brands—not someone who stacks clips together.

You ARE a Fit If...

You think like a filmmaker.

You edit with intention.



You understand when to slow down.



You understand when to create tension.



You understand when silence is more powerful than music.



You remove beautiful shots because they weaken the story.



You care more about narrative than effects.



You obsess over pacing.



You believe great editing is invisible.



Technical Deliverables

Ability to deliver:

4K masters

Website hero videos

Mobile-first versions

Social media derivatives

Optimized web compression

Motion graphic packages

Source project files

Color LUTs

Organized production assets

Bonus Qualifications

Experience with:

Drone cinematography

Corporate documentary production

Commercial advertising

High-end agency work

Product marketing

UI animation

Web video optimization

Photography

Sound design

Creative direction

Brand strategy

Creative AI workflows

Submission Requirements

Applications without the following will not be reviewed.

1. Portfolio

Provide five projects demonstrating different styles of storytelling.

2. Your Best Work

Submit the single best 30–60 second piece you've ever created.

3. Story Breakdown

For one portfolio piece, explain:

Why you selected each scene

Why each cut occurs where it does

How you created emotional progression

What business objective the film was designed to accomplish

4. Workflow

Describe your complete production workflow from raw footage through final delivery.

Include where AI assists your process and where creative judgment remains entirely manual.



5. Software Stack

List every tool you regularly use, including editing, motion graphics, AI, color grading, audio, asset management, and collaboration platforms.

Practical Evaluation

Finalists will receive identical raw footage from a real client.

Your assignment is to produce a flagship brand film suitable for the client's website.



We are not evaluating how many effects you can add.



We are evaluating your ability to:



Discover the story

Build trust

Create emotion

Communicate professionalism

Deliver a commercially effective brand asset

What We Value Most

Software can be learned.

Templates can be purchased.



AI can automate repetitive tasks.



Exceptional judgment cannot.



We're hiring someone who understands how visual storytelling influences perception, trust, and decision-making. The strongest candidates will consistently transform ordinary footage into compelling brand experiences that help businesses communicate credibility, differentiate themselves in competitive markets, and drive measurable business outcomes.
